name: easy-stock
tagline: A-share stock analysis with an LLM-powered research agent
description: easy-stock is a Go-based tool that pairs A-share (Chinese stock market) analysis with an AI research agent built on top of an LLM. It brings together market data and a conversational research layer, letting you ask questions and get reasoned analysis rather than just raw numbers. For investors working the Chinese market, it is a practical bridge between quantitative data and the kind of narrative research an analyst would do by hand. An early, focused entry into LLM-assisted equity research.
highlights: Combines A-share market analysis with an LLM-driven research agent
Go-based backend keeps deployment simple and fast
Conversational interface for reasoned, not just raw, analysis
Early but practical entry into LLM-assisted equity research
curatorNote: Quant tools that add an LLM research layer are quietly becoming a thing, and easy-stock is a clean Go take focused on the A-share market. Great signal for where retail investing tooling is heading.
